name: Multi Time Frame Trader
summary: This EA analyzes multiple timeframes simultaneously to generate trading signals, entering positions only when higher and lower timeframe signals align. It uses a multi-timeframe confluence approach to filter out noise and improve trade quality by requiring agreement across different time horizons. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels while monitoring multiple timeframe conditions for exit signals.
summary_zh: 该EA同时分析多个时间周期以生成交易信号，仅在高低周期信号一致时才开仓。它采用多周期共振方法来过滤噪音并提高交易质量，要求不同时间维度的信号达成一致。EA通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理仓位，同时监控多周期条件作为出场信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是多周期共振交易，通过同时监控多个时间框架（如M15、H1、H4）的技术指标信号来确认交易方向。入场条件要求较短周期和较长周期的信号必须一致，例如短周期出现买入信号的同时长周期趋势也必须向上，这种多重确认机制有效过滤了虚假信号。出场条件包括止损止盈触发、反向信号出现或多个时间框架信号反转。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态仓位计算方式，允许用户选择适合自己的仓位管理模式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和每日最大亏损限制等保护机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，通过多周期分析降低了单一时间框架的误判风险，但也可能因过度过滤而错过部分交易机会。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is multi-timeframe confluence trading, which monitors technical indicator signals across multiple timeframes (such as M15, H1, H4) simultaneously to confirm trade direction. Entry conditions require alignment between shorter and longer timeframe signals — for example, a buy signal on the shorter timeframe must coincide with an upward trend on the longer timeframe, effectively filtering out false signals through multiple confirmation layers. Exit conditions include stop loss and take profit triggers, opposing signal generation, or reversal of signals across multiple timeframes. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage, giving users flexibility to choose their preferred money management approach. Risk management includes maximum position limits and daily maximum loss protection mechanisms to safeguard capital. The overall strategy is logically sound, reducing single-timeframe misjudgment risk through multi-timeframe analysis, though the strict filtering may cause missed trading opportunities during fast-moving markets.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to identify its own orders

pros: 多周期共振过滤虚假信号，提高入场质量
提供灵活的仓位管理选项，支持固定和动态手数
包含止损止盈和最大持仓限制等风险控制机制
策略逻辑清晰，参数可配置性强，适合不同交易风格
多时间框架分析减少单一周期误判概率
pros_en: Multi-timeframe confluence effectively filters false signals and improves entry quality
Flexible position sizing options supporting both fixed and dynamic lot calculations
Includes risk control mechanisms such as stop loss, take profit, and maximum position limits
Clear strategy logic with highly configurable parameters suitable for various trading styles
Multi-timeframe analysis reduces the probability of single-timeframe misjudgment
cons: 多周期确认可能导致入场延迟，错过快速行情的初始阶段
缺乏点差过滤机制，在点差较大时可能不利
未实现新K线检测，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
参数较多，优化不当可能导致过度拟合
缺乏回撤控制和权益曲线监控功能
cons_en: Multi-timeframe confirmation may cause entry delays, missing the initial phase of fast-moving markets
Lacks spread filter mechanism, which can be disadvantageous during high-spread conditions
No new bar detection implemented, potentially causing duplicate entries on the same bar
Many parameters create over-optimization risk if not properly validated
Lacks drawdown control and equity curve monitoring functionality
improvements: 增加新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线上重复开仓
添加点差过滤和时间过滤，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
实现回撤控制机制，当账户回撤超过阈值时暂停交易
improvements_en: Add new bar detection to prevent duplicate entries on the same candle
Implement spread filter and time filter to avoid trading during high-spread and low-liquidity sessions
Add drawdown control mechanism to pause trading when account drawdown exceeds a threshold

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检测可能导致同一根K线重复开仓
没有点差过滤，高点差环境下入场成本偏高
未实现最大回撤保护，极端行情下风险较大
risk_points_en: No new bar detection may cause duplicate entries on the same candle
No spread filter increases entry costs during high-spread conditions
No maximum drawdown protection increases risk during extreme market conditions
